student_message: what's the actual difference between HOMO and LUMO conceptually
reply_text: The HOMO (Highest Occupied Molecular Orbital) is the highest energy orbital that contains electrons, while the LUMO (Lowest Unoccupied Molecular Orbital) is the lowest energy orbital that is empty. Conceptually, the HOMO represents the energy level from which electrons can be removed, and the LUMO represents the energy level to which electrons can be added.

This is part of the experiment's design to evaluate the effect of basis set choice on orbital energies.
